question: Who is known as the 'Martin Luther of India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dayanand Saraswati**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Swami Dayanand Saraswati** is often referred to as the "Martin Luther of India" because,

 
 
• much like Martin Luther in Europe, he was a reformer who challenged orthodox practices and sought to bring about religious and social reforms within Hinduism.
 
 
 
• Dayanand Saraswati founded the **Arya Samaj** in 1875 to reform Hindu society.
